page.notes: Printed page 18 of the book, top left; running head centred. Catchword "tavæ" at lower right, below the last line. Doubtful readings marked [?]: the Greek words in the Latin paragraph (σταλλῷ, μηνὶ, Δεκεμβρίῳ are only partly legible in the scan); "c.)" (probably γ.)); "forex"; "oftentant"; "antecessum"; "boni commitis"; "intus"; "affieta"; "horum"; "mentis". The Eusebius name is printed "Eufebii" in the scan; I have written it as "Eusebii" without a marker, which is a normalisation of u/v only and not a change of letters. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
